body:
Over the years, Healthcare Compliance Pros (HCP) has prided itself in easily accessible and personalized customer service. Our representatives are always on the ready to answer a call or respond to an emailed request for website assistance and step-by-step instructions. But what about those times that you know what you want to do and you just can't remember the final step? Or you're working on a compliance project after hours and just need a set of instructions to finish up your tasks? Or if you learn by doing and would really like to have some instructions to follow at your own pace?

Welcome to our new Technical Support library. We've created step-by-step guides that will walk you through everything from adding a new employee and assigning their training to creating courses using our blank modules. Each guide includes screenshots of the outlined instructions.

Here's where you'll find these great how to guides:

  1. Login to Healthcare Compliance Pros
  2. Open My Office
  3. Select The Forms Tab on the left side of the screen
  4. Select the "Any Category" dropdown and choose "Technical Support"
  5. Click on the support topic you'd like help with and then download or print the document.

At HCP, we continually strive to provide the best service possible. We hope that the Technical Support guides will make managing compliance program just a little bit easier. Questions? Contact [email protected]
